title: Budget — This Month
description: Monthly envelope budgeting (no rollover): budget vs actual per account for the selected month, with remaining and % used. Pick a populated month if the current one has no data yet.

widgets.title: Budget vs Actual
widgets.helpText: A budget on a parent account is compared inclusively against the parent and all its descendants. Empty? This demo needs budgets set (Budgets view) and a month/currency that has data.

steps.query: SELECT account, currency, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS actual FROM postings WHERE account_type = 'Expenses' AND transaction_date BETWEEN :monthStart AND :monthEnd AND currency = :currency GROUP BY account, currency

visualization.emptyText: No budgets or spending for this month. Set budgets in the Budgets view, then pick a month and currency that have data.
